instruction: I like the background cone animation in VLC when no media is playing. Can you make sure it's enabled in VLC settings?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
